title: Sheep eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- grass ground -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='38' ry='6' fill='#4caf50'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='90' rx='38' ry='5' fill='#388e3c'/>
  <!-- sheep body (fluffy cloud-like) -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='52' r='14' fill='#f5f5f5'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='48' r='13' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='52' r='13' fill='#f5f5f5'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='58' r='12' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='58' r='12' fill='#f5f5f5'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='44' r='10' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='40' y='68' width='5' height='16' rx='2' fill='#9e9e9e'/>
  <rect x='52' y='68' width='5' height='16' rx='2' fill='#9e9e9e'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x='39' y='81' width='7' height='4' rx='1.5' fill='#616161'/>
  <rect x='51' y='81' width='7' height='4' rx='1.5' fill='#616161'/>
  <!-- sheep head (dark face) -->
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='46' rx='12' ry='11' fill='#5c6bc0'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='42' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#5c6bc0' transform='rotate(-20 57 42)'/>
  <ellipse cx='75' cy='42' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#5c6bc0' transform='rotate(20 75 42)'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='63' cy='44' r='2.2' fill='#1a1a2e'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='44' r='2.2' fill='#1a1a2e'/>
  <circle cx='63.8' cy='43.4' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='70.8' cy='43.4' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- mouth / eating -->
  <ellipse cx='67' cy='52' rx='3.5' ry='2.5' fill='#3f3f8e'/>
  <!-- snack: carrot in mouth -->
  <polygon points='67,52 80,48 80,53' fill='#ff7043'/>
  <polygon points='80,48 84,50.5 80,53' fill='#ff8a65'/>
  <line x1='70' y1='51' x2='73' y2='50' stroke='#ff5722' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <line x1='73' y1='52' x2='76' y2='51' stroke='#ff5722' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <!-- carrot greens -->
  <ellipse cx='80' cy='47' rx='2' ry='3' fill='#66bb6a' transform='rotate(-30 80 47)'/>
  <ellipse cx='82' cy='49' rx='2' ry='3' fill='#43a047' transform='rotate(20 82 49)'/>
  <!-- wool tuft on top of head -->
  <circle cx='64' cy='36' r='3.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='35' r='3' fill='#f5f5f5'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='54' r='5' fill='#ffffff'/>
</svg>
